name: ALTRESEARCH -- equity research call transcript corpus, joined to Opal ETF weights, to rank alternative-data pipeline opportunities by firm-wide position materiality
description: Andrew-direct commission 2026-07-31 (CRO terminal). Two halves that meet at a join. (A) CORPUS: a structured store at research_transcripts/ for the equity research team's Teams call transcripts -- Andrew pastes each transcript and states its date, CRO structures it into bronze(verbatim)/silver(parsed)/index(mentions). Iterative until the back catalogue is exhausted. (B) MATERIALITY JOIN: collate the corpus for security names appearing in the four Opal ETFs (DIVZ, IDVZ, PFOE, PFDE), then produce a weighted aggregate per security ACROSS the four funds plus ranked weights WITHIN each fund, ordered from the largest position. PREMISE (Andrew, verbatim): 'the heavier the position is in the ETF and for the firm as a whole, those are the most material candidates for ALTRESEARCH alt data pipelines.' The corpus tells us what the research team spends attention on; the ETF weights tell us what the firm has capital behind; the intersection, ranked, is the build queue.

hazards: COVERAGE: a pasted Teams transcript is frequently PARTIAL (transcript 1 = 3.7%). A gap is UNOBSERVED, not empty. Never compute share-of-attention or 'the team never discussed X' from a partial paste without stating the denominator.

TIMESTAMPS: three clocks. Line offsets are ELAPSED from RECORDING start (transcript 1 opens at 2:47, so recording start != meeting start); meeting start is OPERATOR-STATED in Eastern; derived_utc is COMPUTED, never observed. DST offset is passed explicitly, never inferred.
SPEAKER IDENTITY: 'CONFERENCE ROOM' is a room device and may aggregate several people. Speaker-attributed analysis must treat it as unresolved rather than as one analyst.

TWO QUANTITIES, NOT ONE: a weighted aggregate ACROSS funds and a ranked weight WITHIN a fund answer different questions. A name can be a top-5 position in one fund and immaterial firm-wide. Label the basis on every figure -- this is the 0824/0833 lesson in a new place.

DENOMINATOR OF THE AGGREGATE: 'weighted across the 4 ETFs' is ambiguous until the weighting basis is fixed. Weight-by-fund-net-assets (the firm-materiality reading, and the one the premise implies) differs from a simple mean of weight_pct. State the basis in the artifact.
BRONZE: raw/ is byte-faithful and never cleaned. A research call is a one-shot capture -- if the parser drops a line and the raw was tidied first, the content is gone permanently.

SENSITIVITY: internal research-call transcripts carrying non-public views on securities held in Opal funds, git-tracked in a private repo. Consistent with existing workspace practice for positions/client data, but a different content class -- surfaced to Andrew, his call.
